THE FLIGHT MANUAL

Gravity does the steering.

01 / Fall sideways

A tangential launch trades altitude for speed. Near the right speed, your probe keeps falling around the planet.

02 / Change one thing

Keep the angle fixed. Raise speed a little and watch the far side of the orbit grow. Too much speed, and the probe escapes.

03 / Read the prediction

Mint rings are targets. The orange body is solid. A dotted path helps you plan; turn it off for a harder challenge.

Model: a fixed central mass and a massless probe in two dimensions. Inverse-square acceleration; velocity-Verlet integration at 120 steps/s. Units are fictional. No atmosphere, thrust, relativity or real mission planning. Gates accept a 24-unit radius.
